company.name: Ember Steakhouse
company.tagline: Curated Wines for the Refined Table
company.description: Ember Steakhouse is a distinguished wine supplier dedicated to bringing exceptional wines from Europe’s finest regions to discerning restaurants, steakhouses, and private collectors. We carefully select each bottle for quality, character, and perfect pairing potential.
company.address: 14 Vineyard Lane, London, EC2A 4BX, United Kingdom

wines.name: Nyetimber Classic Cuvée
wines.description: Elegant English sparkling wine with fine bubbles, notes of green apple, brioche and citrus. Perfect aperitif.

wines.name: Chapel Down Bacchus
wines.description: Crisp and aromatic English white with elderflower, gooseberry and fresh citrus. Ideal with seafood.

wines.name: Gusbourne Blanc de Blancs
wines.description: Refined single-varietal sparkling wine showing lemon zest, toasted almond and mineral precision.

wines.name: Ridgeview Bloomsbury
wines.description: Award-winning English fizz with red berry, citrus and creamy texture. Excellent with oysters.

wines.name: Bolney Estate Pinot Noir
wines.description: Light-bodied English Pinot with cherry, raspberry and subtle earth. Elegant with duck or salmon.

wines.name: Château Margaux
wines.description: Iconic First Growth Bordeaux. Silky tannins, blackcurrant, violet and refined cedar. Exceptional ageing potential.

wines.name: Domaine de la Romanée-Conti Échézeaux
wines.description: Legendary Burgundy with ethereal red fruit, spice and profound complexity. A true collector’s wine.

wines.name: Château d’Yquem
wines.description: The world’s greatest sweet wine. Honey, apricot, saffron and extraordinary length.

wines.name: Louis Roederer Cristal
wines.description: Prestige cuvée with pure fruit, chalky minerality and seamless texture. Celebratory excellence.

wines.name: Domaine Leflaive Puligny-Montrachet
wines.description: Benchmark white Burgundy. Citrus, white flowers, hazelnut and precise mineral structure.

wines.name: Genoyers Cuvée Prestige
wines.description: Elegant Belgian méthode traditionnelle with fine mousse, green apple and subtle brioche notes.

wines.name: Wijnkasteel Genoels-Elderen Chardonnay
wines.description: Sophisticated Belgian Chardonnay showing citrus, white peach and elegant oak integration.

wines.name: Domein Aldeneyck Pinot Noir
wines.description: Delicate Belgian Pinot with red cherry, forest floor and silky tannins. Surprising finesse.

wines.name: Kluisberg Auxerrois
wines.description: Fresh and floral Belgian white with pear, citrus and a clean mineral finish.

wines.name: Peter Colemont Pinot Gris
wines.description: Rich yet balanced Pinot Gris with stone fruit, honey and a touch of spice.

wines.name: Weingut Dönnhoff Niederhäuser Hermannshöhle Riesling
wines.description: Grand Cru Riesling of pure precision – slate, peach, lime and electric acidity.

wines.name: Dr. Loosen Ürziger Würzgarten Riesling Kabinett
wines.description: Classic Mosel Kabinett with red slate, red berries and vibrant freshness. Off-dry perfection.

wines.name: Weingut Egon Müller Scharzhofberger Riesling
wines.description: Legendary Saar Riesling of ethereal lightness, white peach and profound mineral depth.

wines.name: Weingut Robert Weil Kiedrich Gräfenberg Riesling GG
wines.description: Grand Cru Rheingau Riesling with citrus, floral notes and remarkable structure.

wines.name: Weingut Keller G-Max Riesling
wines.description: Ultra-rare dry Riesling of extraordinary concentration and purity. A modern German icon.

wines.name: Antinori Tignanello
wines.description: Pioneering Super Tuscan with black cherry, spice, tobacco and refined tannins.

wines.name: Gaja Barbaresco
wines.description: Elegant Nebbiolo with rose petal, cherry, tar and silky yet firm structure.

wines.name: Ornellaia
wines.grape: Cabernet Sauvignon, Merlot, Cabernet Franc, Petit Verdot
wines.description: Bolgheri masterpiece of power and elegance. Dark fruit, graphite and Mediterranean herbs.

wines.name: Biondi-Santi Brunello di Montalcino
wines.description: Historic Brunello of purity and longevity. Cherry, violet, leather and refined acidity.

wines.name: Quintarelli Amarone della Valpolicella
wines.description: Legendary Amarone of profound depth, dried fruit, spice and extraordinary complexity.

wines.name: Vega Sicilia Único
wines.description: Spain’s most iconic wine. Black fruit, cedar, tobacco and decades of ageing potential.

wines.name: Marqués de Riscal Gran Reserva
wines.description: Classic Rioja Gran Reserva with strawberry, vanilla, leather and silky elegance.

wines.name: Pingus
wines.description: Cult Ribera del Duero of pure power and finesse. Dark berry, mineral and seamless texture.

wines.name: Álvaro Palacios L’Ermita
wines.description: Priorat icon from steep slate slopes. Intense fruit, mineral and remarkable purity.

wines.name: CVNE Imperial Gran Reserva
wines.description: Historic Rioja of elegance and complexity. Red fruit, spice, balsamic and fine tannins.

wines.name: Luskus Sparkling
wines.description: Ireland’s pioneering méthode traditionnelle. Crisp apple, citrus and fine persistent mousse.

wines.name: Blackwater Valley Vineyard Pinot Noir
wines.description: Delicate Irish Pinot with red cherry, rose and light earthy notes. A rare expression.

wines.name: Thomas Walk Vineyard Bacchus
wines.description: Aromatic Irish white with elderflower, gooseberry and bright acidity. Fresh and lively.

wines.name: Wicklow Way Wines Chardonnay
wines.description: Elegant cool-climate Chardonnay with citrus, green apple and subtle oak.

wines.name: Longueville House Estate Red
wines.description: Structured Irish red blend with blackcurrant, plum and soft tannins. Surprisingly refined.
